source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("smart city" OR "smart cities") AND (critical OR governance OR citizens OR citizenship OR neoliberal OR corporate)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("smart city" OR "smart cities") AND (critical OR governance OR citizens OR citizenship OR neoliberal OR corporate),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("smart cities" OR "smart city") AND ("citizens" OR "citizenship" OR "corporate" OR "critical" OR "governance" OR "neoliberal"))
